title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
blurb: A 671B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 37B active parameters per token, built on latent attention, fine-grained experts, bias-based load balancing and multi-token prediction.
intro: Each DeepSeek-V3 layer pairs multi-head latent attention (MLA), which caches a small latent per token instead of full keys and values, with a DeepSeekMoE feed-forward: one shared expert plus many small routed experts chosen by sigmoid affinities. Load is balanced by adjusting per-expert routing biases instead of an auxiliary loss, and extra modules predict tokens further ahead during training. The steps build MLA, the router and the MoE machinery separately; the capstone assembles one full block.
